patch.name: change.patch
patch.text:
diff --git a/payments/retry.py b/payments/retry.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/payments/retry.py
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+import time
+
+
+def charge_with_retry(client, payment_id, amount):
+    for attempt in range(3):
+        try:
+            return client.charge(payment_id, amount, timeout=8)
+        except client.TransientGatewayError:
+            if attempt == 2:
+                raise
+            time.sleep(2 ** attempt)
